descriptions.w3d_actor_fire_punch_jump: Starts the fire punch jump state and posts its message for an eligible entity.
descriptions.w3d_actor_link_c_state: Reads the third linked object state and clears a stale identifier.
descriptions.w3d_actor_link_b_query: Queries the second linked object and clears a stale identifier.
descriptions.w3d_actor_link_b_active: Reads the second linked object active field and clears a stale identifier.
descriptions.w3d_actor_post_pair_query: Posts the stored pair of values and returns whether the global result is zero.
descriptions.w3d_actor_link_a_flag: Reads the first linked object flag and clears a stale identifier.
descriptions.w3d_actor_link_a_state: Reads the first linked object state and clears a stale identifier.
descriptions.w3d_actor_link_a_second_flag: Reads the first linked object second flag and clears a stale identifier.
descriptions.w3d_actor_clear_links: Clears three linked identifiers, optionally posts notifications, and resets the matching owner state.
descriptions.w3d_actor_timed_value: Sets a timed actor value and schedules its next update from a scaled clock reading.
descriptions.w3d_actor_link_c_falling_message: Posts a notification when the third link exists and vertical velocity is below its threshold.
descriptions.w3d_actor_link_a_falling_step: Updates an eligible first linked object while falling and clears a stale identifier.
descriptions.w3d_actor_other_entity_reaction: Chooses an actor reaction based on whether the other entity is on the same team.
